name: OpenAI reusable prompts and Evals shut down on 30 Nov 2026
gain: The v1/prompts API, reusable prompt objects, and the Evals dashboard and API are scheduled to shut down on 30 Nov 2026.
how: Move reusable prompt content into application code, and move evals to another tool. OpenAI's page links a cookbook for moving to Promptfoo.
trade_offs: Prompts in code need a deploy to change.
Existing evals became read-only on 31 Oct 2026, so history needs exporting before the shutdown.
needs: Engineering time, and an eval tool if the product runs evals.

gain_model.formula: no money figure: the call stops working or a capability is missing

verify_rule: The old id or parameter is gone and calls succeed over 7 days
